rationale: This article is an editorial overview introducing a symposium volume of three plenary session papers on general physical infrastructure, trade expansion, and macroeconomic growth in Africa. It reports neither primary empirical research nor a systematic review (E05), and it mentions water and sanitation only in passing within a broad sectoral list of macroeconomic infrastructure rather than examining household or community service access outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both the narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because this record is a non-empirical special-issue overview summarizing three plenary papers on macroeconomic infrastructure, trade, and growth rather than an empirical study or systematic review of household or community water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Infrastructure and Economic Development in Africa: An Overview
This volume, therefore, contains the three papers presented at that plenary session.
